title: An Umbrella for the Walk Home
context: 办公室同事 Nina 发现下雨没带伞，向同事 Carl 借伞并约定归还。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，内容和练习题均为原创，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: The rain is really coming down, and I left my umbrella at home.
dialogue.zh: 雨下得真大，而我把伞忘在家里了。

dialogue.speaker: Carl
dialogue.en: I have a spare one in my desk. Would you like to borrow it?
dialogue.zh: 我桌子里有一把备用的。你想借用吗？

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: That would be great. Are you sure you won't need it?
dialogue.zh: 那太好了。你确定自己不需要吗？

dialogue.speaker: Carl
dialogue.en: I'm getting a ride home, so I won't need it today.
dialogue.zh: 有人开车送我回家，所以我今天用不上。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Thank you. I'll bring it back to the office tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我明天把它带回办公室。

dialogue.speaker: Carl
dialogue.en: No problem. It's the blue one with the wooden handle.
dialogue.zh: 没问题。就是那把木柄蓝伞。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: I see it. Does it fold up?

dialogue.speaker: Carl
dialogue.en: Yes. Press the button on the handle to close it.
dialogue.zh: 能。按手柄上的按钮就能收起来。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Got it. I'll let it dry before I bring it back.
dialogue.zh: 明白了。我会晾干之后再带回来。

dialogue.speaker: Carl
dialogue.en: Thanks. You can leave it on my desk if I'm in a meeting.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。如果我在开会，你可以把它放在我桌上。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: I will. I hope your ride gets here soon.
dialogue.zh: 好的。希望接你的人快点到。

dialogue.speaker: Carl
dialogue.en: Thanks, and have a safe walk home.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，你走回家路上小心。

expressions.example: The snow was coming down when we left.
I keep a spare in my bag.

expressions.zh: 搭便车或有人开车接送。
expressions.example: Can you get a ride to the station?
This chair folds up for easy storage.
Let the towel dry near the window.

pronunciation: umbrella 重音在第二音节 BREL；spare 开头的 /sp/ 要连在一起，不要在两个辅音中间加元音。

practice.title: Part 1 · Rainy days
practice.prompt: What do you usually carry on a rainy day?
practice.answer: I usually take a small umbrella and a bag that can keep my books dry. I also check the weather before leaving home.

practice.title: Part 2 · Help on a rainy day
practice.prompt: Describe a time someone helped you on a rainy day. Say where you were, what happened, and how you thanked them.
practice.answer: One afternoon I left work and saw heavy rain outside. I had forgotten my umbrella, and I had a long walk home. A coworker offered me a spare umbrella because she was getting a ride. I thanked her and promised to return it the next day. At home I left it open to dry, and the next morning I put it on her desk with a short thank you note. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Small acts of help
practice.prompt: Why can small acts of help matter at work?
practice.answer: They can make a difficult moment easier and show that coworkers notice one another. Over time, such kindness may make people feel more comfortable asking for help.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读借伞的对话，再说明忘带伞的情况并约定归还时间。
practice.answer: I forgot my umbrella, and it's raining hard. Could I borrow your spare one? I'll bring it back tomorrow.
